slug_check.name: slug_check
slug_check.value: length("doc"."slug") <= 64 and "doc"."slug" glob '[a-z0-9]*' and "doc"."slug" not glob '*[^a-z0-9-]*'

subject_check.name: subject_check
subject_check.value: ("doc"."scope" in ('machine','global') and "doc"."subject" is null) or ("doc"."scope" in ('project','agent','job','resume') and "doc"."subject" is not null)
